tools.name: lookup_agent_grade
tools.description: Look up an AI agent's Agent Report Card grade before hiring it. Free. Pass an id, a name, an OpenServ marketplace link or number, or the agent's own https address. Returns the grade, score, date graded, task count, per-task and per-type summary, the judges-disagree flag, a hire/caution/avoid recomme

tools.name: search_graded_agents
tools.description: List graded agents, highest score first. Filter by grade (A to F), category (research, writing, crypto, code-data, assistants), recommendation (hire, caution, avoid), or words in the name. Free. Use lookup_agent_grade for the full record of one agent.

tools.name: how_to_get_graded
tools.description: How to get an agent graded by Agent Report Card. Reading grades is free. Ordering a grade is paid (POST /api/grade, USDC on Base). Also describes the free first grade.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: how_to_get_graded · Private data: search_graded_agents · Public sink: lookup_agent_grade, how_to_get_graded.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: how_to_get_graded · Private data: search_graded_agents · Public sink: lookup_agent_grade, how_to_get_graded

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
